articles.summary: Pelagos Insurance Capital Limited (NYSE:PLGO) ("Pelagos Insurance Capital" or the "Company"), a global specialty insurer and reinsurer, announced today that it expects to release financial results for the second quarter ended June 30, 2026, on August 12, 2026, after the close of the financial markets. These documents will be available via the Investors section of the Company’s website at https://investors.pelagosinsurancecapital.com . Dan Burrows, Group Chief Executive Officer, Allan Decleir, Group Chief Financial Officer, and Jonny Strickle, Group Managing Director, will host an investor teleconference, including a question-and-answer session, on August 13, 2026, at 9:00 a.m. ET to discuss the second quarter results as well as related matters. The teleconference can be accessed by dialing 1-800-715-9871 (U.S. callers), or 1-646-307-1963 (international callers), and entering the passcode 8797451 approximately 10 minutes in advance of the call. A live, listen-only webcast of the call
articles.title: Pelagos Insurance Capital Schedules Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results Conference Call
